movie.title: Madfabulous
movie.overview: When the flamboyant Henry Paget arrives in 1890s North Wales to claim his aristocratic inheritance, his theatrical flair and defiant eccentricities send shockwaves through the upper-class elite, much to the amusement of the local townspeople. Alongside his spirited cousin, Lily, and loyal butler, Gelert, Henry tries to carve out his own identity as the Fifth Marquess, navigating suffocating traditions, scheming relatives, and the long shadow cast by his estranged father.

credits.character: Henry Cyril Paget, 5th Marquess of Anglesey

reviews.author: CinemaSerf
reviews.content: If you've got the vaguest hint of flamboyance in your character, then the role of "Henry" here would have to be your plum role. It certainly appears to be for Callum Scott Howells who looks like he has thrown just about everything he has to give at his role as the infamous Lord Paget. He was the elder son of the Marquess of Anglesey - whom he had never met - and lived comfortably on that island assisted by his elderly butler Gelert (Rupert Everett). Paget is bored, frustrated and lonely and but for his best friend - his dog - finds his life tedious. Then he meets Lily (Ruby Stokes), a distant relative, who encourages him to break from the rigid behavioural mould of his aristocratic background and spend some of his significant fortune on frivolity. Next thing, he is squandering with aplomb buying the finest clothes, jewellery and has engaged the services of the duplicitous Durrant (pronounced Durront - he's French don't you know) who encourages even greater profligacy with grand theatrical performances produced by him (Tom Rhys Harries) and performed by his company of talentless spongers. Sadly, Henry hasn't the intellectual wherewithal to realise just what is going on around him and is content to coast along irresponsibly until a trio of tragedies land on his doorstep and leave him reeling. Howells is on great form throughout delivering engagingly a combination of entitled foppishness and almost childlike insecurity especially well. The supporting cast also add quite a bit of richness to this story, especially those playing folks who were perfectly content to fleece the man when he was in clover but who were soon hovering like vultures once the tap ran dry. The production design has something of the look of a Peter Greenaway film to it with sumptuous costumes and locations and the slightest hint of farce to it at times, too, and though it does have it's fallow sequences, it is still an enjoyable entertainment that is part pantomime and part social commentary and it's worth a couple of hours if you like your comedy more of the carcass-picking vein.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Upon inheriting his title in 1890s North Wales, the flamboyant Fifth Marquess of Anglesey defies suffocating aristocratic traditions alongside his spirited cousin and loyal butler.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: In 1890s North Wales, the eccentric and theatrical Henry Paget arrives to claim his aristocratic inheritance as the Fifth Marquess. His unapologetic individuality delights the local townspeople but scandalizes the rigid upper-class elite. Supported by his vibrant cousin, Lily, and his dependable butler, Gelert, Henry strives to carve out his own identity while resisting suffocating traditions. However, he must constantly navigate scheming relatives and the looming shadow of his estranged father.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Set against the backdrop of late 19th-century North Wales, Henry Paget steps into his inheritance as the Fifth Marquess of Anglesey with unparalleled theatricality and flair. Unwilling to conform to the stiff expectations of the Victorian aristocracy, his vibrant personality immediately alienates the local high society. While the elite view his extravagant lifestyle and defiance as an embarrassment, the local working-class townspeople find endless amusement and joy in his theatrical exploits. Flanked by his free-spirited cousin Lily and his steadfast butler Gelert, Henry turns his estate into a haven for artistic expression. Beneath the grand spectacles, however, Henry struggles with deep-seated feelings of isolation and the heavy emotional weight left behind by his distant father. His path to self-definition is further complicated by conniving relatives who view his eccentricities as an opportunity to undermine his claim. As pressure mounts from both society and family, Henry doubles down on his commitment to authenticity. Ultimately, the story charts his resilient quest to stay true to himself despite a world determined to force him into a conventional mold.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Madfabulous explores the true spirit of individuality through the life of Henry Paget, the Fifth Marquess of Anglesey. Arriving in 1890s North Wales to take control of his immense estate, Henry's flamboyant wardrobe, lavish artistic productions, and complete disregard for Victorian decorum turn upper-class society upside down. Rather than succumbing to the pressures of his title, Henry embraces his unique identity, championed by his devoted inner circle comprising his spirited cousin Lily and loyal butler Gelert. The narrative highlights the sharp contrast between the scandalized nobility and the delighted common folk, framing Henry's life as a battle between oppressive aristocratic expectation and joyous self-expression. As family intrigue and social pressures threaten to strip him of his legacy, Henry must navigate betrayal and deep personal vulnerabilities to protect his freedom and legacy.

story_structure.climax: Tensions reach a boiling point as the upper-class establishment and treacherous relatives attempt to strip Henry of his standing, forcing him to face the ultimate challenge to his independence and identity.
story_structure.conflict: Henry's unapologetic theatricality and defiant eccentricities clash directly with the suffocating traditions of the upper-class elite, his scheming relatives, and the imposing legacy of his estranged father.
story_structure.resolution: Henry confronts the shadow of his legacy, leaving an indelible mark on North Wales and defining what it truly means to live authentically on his own terms.
story_structure.introduction: Flamboyant Henry Paget arrives in 1890s North Wales accompanied by his loyal companion Gelert and his cousin Lily to assume his role and claim his vast aristocratic inheritance as the Fifth Marquess.
story_structure.risingAction: As Henry attempts to carve out a distinct identity through grand, ostentatious displays, he wins the affection of the local townspeople while navigating increasingly hostile social pushback and familial plots to undermine his status.
